Lemma
[the joining velocity is uniformly small on a small ball]

↗ lem:dc-ch3-4-2-pairsmall ↗ lem:dc-ch3-4-2-invdiagonal ↗ thm:dc-ch3-3-7

1. ch3:4.2With the inverse pair map $\mathrm{Ginv}$ of item 5, $C^1$ (hence continuous) on its open diffeomorphism image $U\ni (\varphi _p(p),\varphi _p(p))$ and fixing the center diagonal (section 3): for every $r>0$ there is $\beta >0$ with $\overline{B_\beta (p)}$ inside the chart source and, for all $q_1,q_2\in \overline{B_\beta (p)}$, the joining chart velocity $v=(\mathrm{Ginv}(\varphi _p(q_1),\varphi _p(q_2)))_2$ obeys $\| v\| <r$.
Proof

\sketch

Apply section 3 to $\Psi (x)=(\mathrm{Ginv}(x))_2$. This $\Psi $ is continuous at the center (restriction of the continuous $\mathrm{Ginv}$ to the open $U$, followed by the second projection) and vanishes there by section 3.

□
